summary: Round 3 batch over the Cogito/existence base and the Aristotelian analyses (explorations/cogito-thought-occurs.toml and siblings): ten zero-axiom derivations in TruthCore/Results/Causality/Round3CogitoBase/Solution.lean, each from OPEN analyst premises. Thought occurrence by retorsion from a performed doubt and the doubting-is-thinking bridge, plus the retorsion itself (a performed doubt of thought falsifies its content); borne thought as opining through assent; the selected being as an actual concretum from the thought it bears; a natural-number grounding rank giving well-founded actual grounding (a non-circular second route) and, with excluded middle, the borrowing cut; cone well-foundedness from global well-foundedness (strength order); cone contingent grounding from the absence of a contingent root ancestor; potency as unactualized capacity through privation; being moved as actualization of potency through unactualized capacity. Controls: omission models for every load-bearing premise except excluded middle, and three joint nonvacuity witnesses. No premise is established; the targets are relocated to the new open premises. STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD and STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE get no new derivation (see ATTEMPT-ROUND3-COGITO-BASE-REJECTED-EDGES).
